geometries.name: Walter Schauberger egg curve
geometries.construction: rotate xy=1 about the y-axis -> hyperbolic cone; project a hyperbolic spiral; intersect with an inclined plane

parameters.z0: height where the cutting plane meets the vertical axis
parameters.alpha: inclination of the cutting plane to the horizontal
parameters.z1,z2: heights of the sharp and blunt principal vertices

geometries.name: Elliptic-coordinate vortex
geometries.construction: closed elliptic streamlines; exact nonlinear solution of the compressible Euler equation

open_discrepancy.statement: GEO-A's generating relation xy=1 rotated about the y-axis is not demonstrably the same surface as GEO-B's z = 0.079/r^2.

separation_rule: New Schauberger hypotheses must not be merged into the existing quantum-solver evidence; the comparison is a separate branch.
